acceptBranchNoCommits: Accept not completed: this tree's branch ({branch}) has no commits, so no PR can be opened. The change may be on another branch; push the commits to {branch}, then retry the accept
acceptConflicted: Accept not completed: PR #{pr} conflicts with its target branch, so the code hosting service cannot merge it now. The conflict has to be resolved in the task directory; accept again once the checks are green
acceptFocusTooLong: Review focus takes at most {items} items and {chars} characters in total, one sentence each, saying what the reviewer should check. Test results and how you verified the change go in body
acceptNeedsViewedCommit: Accepting needs the commit of the version you viewed
acceptPrNotMerged: Accept not completed: the PR could not be merged ({why}). Retry the accept once this is sorted out
acceptPrOpenFailed: Accept not completed: the PR couldn't be opened; the review details say why. Without a PR the platform won't push the change directly. Fix it, then accept again
acceptRepositoryUnreadable: Accept not completed: the project's code repository can't be read right now. Try accepting again later
acceptReviewerOnly: Only the assigned reviewer can accept
acceptTitleDisagrees: Accept not completed: the title of PR #{pr} on GitHub differs from the title it was submitted for review with. Have the AI teammate set the review title to the line that should land with cheese_card(action=describe), then accept once the checks pass
aiCannotOwnChange: AI can't {action} its own changes. A person has to do it
artifactActionBoth: Give only one of artifact and new_artifact: this delivery is either a new version of an entry on the list, or something not yet on it.
artifactActionMissing:
This delivery doesn't say which artifact it changes. When you hand over a file or an address, use one of the two:
  artifact=<id of the entry on the list>    this delivery is a new version of that entry
  new_artifact=<its real name>          this delivery makes something not yet on the list
The list is in the system prompt under “This project's artifact list”, with each entry's id printed next to its name; creating one returns its new id.
artifactActionUnwanted: A merge hands over this project's repository itself, so no artifact needs declaring: the platform knows which entry on the list it is, and this delivery becomes its new version. artifact / new_artifact / about are only for handing over a file (deliver) or an address (deliver_url).
autoMergeNeedsOpenPr: Only a change awaiting review with an open PR can be set to auto-merge
autoMergeNotEnabled: Auto-merge isn't turned on for this project. You can turn it on in the project settings
autoMergeReviewerOnly: Only the assigned reviewer can set auto-merge
checksDidNotRun: Checks couldn't run. Resubmit for review before accepting
checksFailedResubmit: Checks failed. The change will be resubmitted for review once it's fixed
checksStillRunning: Checks are still running. The change can be accepted once they pass
commitSubjectEmpty: The commit title can't be empty
commitSubjectOneLine: The commit title can only be one line. Put the explanation in the body
deliverUrlInvalid: deliver_url must be an address that opens (http:// or https://)
deliverableBoth: Give only one of deliver and deliver_url: what this delivery hands over is either a file or an address.
deliverableChanged: The deliverable was replaced and the version you saw is out of date. Review it again before you {action}
deliverableTooLarge: {path} is {size}MB, over the {max}MB limit for one deliverable. When what you hand over is an address, record it with deliver_url.
dependencyAwaitsParent: Wait until “{title}” is accepted first, or change this task and submit it for review again
dependencyBaseChanged: This task's comparison base has changed. Refresh and review it again
dependencyUnconfirmed: Can't confirm the task this one depends on right now. Refresh and try again later
forgeKindUnknown: The project's code hosting type isn't recognized
forgejoListUnreadable: Forgejo returned a list that can't be read
forgejoMergeUnconfirmed: Forgejo hasn't confirmed the merge yet. Refresh and try again
githubBranchComparisonInvalid: GitHub returned an unusable branch comparison. Try again later.
githubNoPrNodeId: GitHub didn't return the PR's node_id
githubRefusedCheckStatus: GitHub refused to report the check status (HTTP {status}): {reply}
githubRefusedCommitOrder: GitHub refused to compare the order of two commits (HTTP {status}): {reply}
githubRefusedCommitRead: GitHub refused to read the commit (HTTP {status}): {reply}
githubRefusedCompare: GitHub refused to compare the range of changes (HTTP {status}): {reply}
githubRefusedMerge: GitHub refused to merge the PR (HTTP {status}): {reply}
githubRefusedOpenPr: GitHub refused to open the PR (HTTP {status}): {reply}
githubRefusedPrStatus: GitHub refused to report the PR status (HTTP {status}): {reply}
githubRefusedUpdateBranch: GitHub refused to update the branch of PR #{number} (HTTP {status}): {reply}
legacyCardNoTask: This older submission isn't linked to a task. Create a new task and submit it for review from there
mergeQueueLeaveUnsupported: The current repository connection can't leave the merge queue. Check the repository connection.
neverShown: No version had been shown yet. It has been refreshed; review it before you {action}
neverShownPr: No version of PR #{pr} had been shown yet. It has been refreshed; review it before you {action}
overrideListOnly: Only people on the override list in the project's branch protection can let it through (with no list set, the project owner or a team admin)
overrideNoGithubCredentials: Can't get the GitHub authorization to merge this PR right now ({why})
overridePendingOnly: Only a change awaiting review can be let through by hand
overrideSignIn: Sign in to let it through by hand
overrideTitleDisagrees: The title of PR #{pr} on GitHub differs from the title it was submitted for review with, so merging anyway would write a title the repository's checks never saw into history. Have the AI teammate set the review title to the line that should land with cheese_card(action=describe), then accept once the checks pass
prBaseUpdateFailed: Can't update the PR's target branch right now: {reason}
prMergedCantWithdraw: The PR is already merged, so the merge request can't be withdrawn. Refresh to see it
prNewCommitsAfterView: PR #{number} got new commits after you looked at it. The card has been refreshed; look again before accepting
prNewCommitsDuringAccept: PR #{number} got new commits while it was being accepted. The card has been refreshed; look again before accepting
prNewCommitsDuringOverride: PR #{number} got new commits while it was being let through. The card has been refreshed; look again before letting it through
protocolExternalAccept: Under the institution agreement, this channel must be accepted by an external member
reassignSignIn: Sign in to pass the review to someone else
redeliverMergeCard: This card hands over the merge itself, so there is no file or address to replace. Push new commits to the existing PR with cheese push-fix
redeliverNoPendingCard: This task has no review waiting, so there is no deliverable to replace. If the card already has an outcome, submit a new review for the new version
redeliverNothing: Nothing to replace it with: give deliver (a file in the task directory) or deliver_url (an address)
repositoryBaseUnconfirmed: The repository hasn't confirmed the new target branch yet. Try again later
repositoryUnavailableForDependency: The project's code repository isn't available right now, so the dependency can't be removed
returnReviewerOnly: Only the assigned reviewer can send it back
returnSignIn: Sign in to send it back
reviewCheckOnlyWhenWaiting: Only a review waiting on checks can record check results
reviewCommentAlreadySent: The comment has been sent and can no longer be changed
reviewCommentBadLines: The comment's line numbers are invalid
reviewCommentBadPlace: The comment's location in the file is invalid
reviewCommentNotAllowed: Only the task's owner, contributors and reviewer can comment
reviewCommentNotAwaitingReview: Comments can only be written while the task awaits review
reviewCommentNotSendable: One of the comments to send can't be sent. Refresh and try again
reviewCommentOutcomeUnknown: The previous review's comments have no comment {id}
reviewEndedNoAccept: The review has ended; it can't be accepted again
reviewEndedNoApprove: The review has ended; it can't be approved
reviewEndedNoReassign: The review has ended; it can't be passed to someone else
reviewEndedNoReturn: The review has ended; it can't be sent back
reviewEndedNoVoid: The review has ended; there's nothing to void
reviewForgeMismatch: The review's hosting service doesn't match the project repository's
reviewNoPendingCard: This channel has no pending review, so there's no description to change
reviewNoRepository: The project has no code repository, so the review can't be acted on
reviewNoRepositoryForAccept: The project has no code repository, so accepting isn't available yet
reviewRepositoryChanged: The project's repository has changed, so the earlier review can't be applied to the new repository
reviewerNotAPerson: The reviewer has to be a person: {handle} is an AI teammate, and nobody could accept a change handed to it. Choose a member to review instead.
reviewerNotInTopic: Reviewer {handle} isn't in the project this channel belongs to, so nobody could accept the review if it went to them. Add them to the project first, or choose another reviewer (look up the exact handle with `cheese_room(action=members)`).
reviewerUnnamed: The submission doesn't say who reviews it, and the project has no default reviewer. Name a person (`cheese_room(action=members)` gives the exact handle), or fill one in under “Branch protection → Default task reviewer” in the project settings.
reviewersDiffer: These tasks were started with different reviewers ({reviewers}), and the platform won't choose for you. Name one when you submit for review.
revokeAcceptForbidden: Only the person who accepted it, the project owner or a team admin can revoke the accept
revokeAcceptSignIn: Sign in to revoke the accept
revokeAcceptedOnly: Only an accepted change can have its accept revoked
staleView: There are new commits and the version you saw is out of date. Review it again before you {action}
staleViewPr: PR #{pr} has new commits and the version you saw is out of date. Review it again before you {action}
taskBranchNothingToDeliver: The task branch {branch} has no changes to deliver
taskEndedOrNoBranch: This task has ended or has no working branch
taskNoPrForDependency: The task has no PR yet. Sync its commits before removing the dependency
topicArchivedCannotReview: The channel is archived, so it can't be submitted for review
topicArchivedNoAccept: The channel is archived, so this can't be accepted
topicArchivedNoReview: The channel is archived, so nothing more can be submitted for review
versionNotAFile: What this version delivered isn't a file
voidForbidden: Only the assigned reviewer, the project owner or a team admin can void it
